content.text: {"blindExactMatch":true,"canonicalSetUniquelyDefensible":true,"canonicalSetExplanation":"The canonical set is uniquely defensible from the standalone stem alone. C3 is the only condition consistent with recurrent CGM-documented readings of 58–64 mg/dL accompanied by adrenergic and neuroglycopenic symptoms occurring exclusively during or within one hour after the new cycling routine, while noncycling fasting and premeal readings remain 95–140 mg/dL; C1 is contradicted by the explicit denial of fever, vomiting, ketones, and recent illness, and C2 is contradicted by the low rather than elevated readings and the absence of ketones. Among actions, A2 addresses the stated root cause that the preexisting meal and insulin plan was continued without an exercise-day adjustment, and correctly routes carbohydrate and medication changes through the prescriber or DSMES team rather than an independent change; A3 secures immediate safety before the next ride given repeated symptomatic lows. A1 is contradicted because increasing insulin would deepen hypoglycemia and exceeds independent scope, and A4 is contradicted because the remedy is an aligned plan, not permanent cessation of beneficial activity. Among parameters, P2 captures the peri-exercise glucose trajectory that defines the problem and its resolution, and P1 captures recurrence and timing, which is the direct outcome measure of a revised plan; P3 is contradicted by the stated absence of ketones, illness, and hyperglycemia, and P4 has no premise in the stem, which supplies no blood pressure or cardiovascular data. No two-item substitution within either the action or parameter pool preserves defensibility, so the 1/2/2 keyed set is free-generated condition 'exercise-induced hypoglycemia' is semantically equivalent to canonical C3 'activity-associated hypoglycemia from a plan not aligned with the new exercise routine'.","Stage 1 free-generated priority action 1 was immediate 15 g fast-acting carbohydrate treatment with 15-minute recheck, which maps onto A3; Stage 1 priority action 2 combined preexercise carbohydrate with insulin reduction 'per provider protocol', which maps onto A2 once the pool restricts regimen changes to prescriber/DSMES-directed planning."],"stage1Alignment":"FULL","stage1AlignmentExplanation":"The Stage 1 blind free-generation produced, without any pool cues, a condition and both action and parameter categories that map one-to-one onto the canonical keyed tokens. Stage 1 named 'exercise-induced hypoglycemia', which is the same construct as C3. Its first priority action (treat with 15 g rapid-acting carbohydrate and recheck in 15 minutes) corresponds to A3's rapid-acting carbohydrate and prompt low-treatment instructions, and its second (preexercise carbohydrate plus insulin reduction on exercise days per provider protocol) corresponds to A2's individualized exercise-day carbohydrate and medication plan created with the prescriber or DSMES team. Its two evaluation parameters (CGM before, during, and for several hours after cycling including overnight; and recurrence and severity of hypoglycemia symptoms on cycling versus noncycling days) correspond directly to P2 and P1 respectively. Stage 2 then selected exactly the canonical labels. Alignment is therefore FULL across both blind stages, with the only differences being wording granularity and the ordering of the two parameters.","anyCanonicalTargetDependsOnAbsentFact":false,"unstatedClientFactMateriallyChangesRankability":false}
